future_primary_endpoint.scale: ln(eta/(1 Pa s)); natural logarithm, with registered physical units
future_primary_endpoint.scope: Each declared native hidden rate strictly above the largest of six lawful anchors; at least2 targets and exact frozen support.
future_primary_endpoint.quadrature: Endpoint half-gaps/interior half-neighbor gaps in log(rate), normalized over[first hidden,last hidden]. Highest-anchor-to-first-hidden gap explicitly reported and excluded; no interpolated endpoint loss.
future_primary_endpoint.aggregation: Average fixed masks within original curve, curves within independent unit, then units equally; compare identical complete units/targets across fixed methods.
future_primary_endpoint.primary_difference: Unit-level GaussianCRPS(primary)-GaussianCRPS(comparator); negative favors primary. No invented confidence interval or superiority finding.
future_primary_endpoint.other_diagnostics: Raw GaussianCRPS and joint density remain scores of the unchanged law. Raw and conformal finite-grid coverage, width and interval score are separately labelled. The band has no CRPS or joint density.

calibration_contract_summary.unit_score: R_g=max over all predeclared curves/masks/targets in one independent physical unit of abs(y-mu)/sigma, with finite positive sigma.
calibration_contract_summary.rank_rule: k=ceil((ncal+1)*(1-alpha)) by exact rational arithmetic; q=sorted_scores[k-1] whenk<=ncal, otherwise unbounded.
calibration_contract_summary.assumption: Exchangeability of entire calibration and future unit objects under the same registered source/state/measurement/query policy, conditional on frozen prior choices.
calibration_contract_summary.claim: Marginal whole-unit finite-grid coverage; not chemistry/anchor-conditional, continuous-curve, arbitrary-domain or calibrated-density coverage.
calibration_contract_summary.small_sample_rule: Keep infinite/vacuous set explicit. Do not clamp k, interpolate a quantile, tunealpha, omit failures or call unbounded coverage useful calibration.
calibration_contract_summary.selection_rule: Each fixed comparator uses its own q on the same calibration units. No candidate selection based on calibration q/width; any selection requires separate lawful development/selection and fresh final calibration.
